name: al-quran-desktop
description: Al-Quran Cross-Platform Desktop Application (Read, Listen, Reflect)
author: Ashraful Anam Alve

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:main
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:main && electron .
scripts.package:win: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:main && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:portable: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:main && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.package:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:main && electron-builder -mwl
